text:
Priya K: Hey team — customer AcmeAI hitting intermittent 502/503s on hosted inference streaming endpoint (/v1/generate?stream=true). Started ~08:10 UTC. They use SDK v1.3.2 with http2 multiplex disabled. Client logs show 'reading body' hang then ECONNRESET. They also reported duplicate billing for retried calls.
Alex M: Thanks — can you paste the request-id + raw headers from their failing call? Multiplex off could cause more TCP handshakes. Also suspect proxy keepalive mismatch.
Priya K: request_id=r-34a8f2c5, from edge logs: "upstream reset" and "connection closed by peer". Example client error: "Error: read ECONNRESET at Socket.read (internal/stream_base_commons.js:...)". Customer says retries are default; billing shows two charge events for same time window.
Support Bot: Created ticket INC-12456 and linked to the thread.
Mike S: I tried a quick repro from my laptop: 

curl --http2 -vv -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -N -d @prompt.json "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?stream=true"

Response snippet:
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/2
< HTTP/2 200
data: {"id":"...","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello"}}]}
... (streaming chunks)
... then after ~22s
read: Connection reset by peer

So server closed mid-stream.
Alex M: Can you also share their client keepalive settings? If the client is closing earlier than LB, TLS reneg could show up.
Priya K: Customer keeps default node http.Agent settings (socketTimeout ~60000). Load balancer idle timeout appears to be 90s in infra config. We see a cluster of similar errors at 08:09:52.
Eng Oncall: I pulled proxy logs — at 08:09:52 there are TLS handshake errors and "stream closed with error: HTTP/2 stream cancelled" across many edge hosts. This looks like idle stream eviction combined with a backend restart spike. Rolling a hotfix: bumping edge proxy keepalive and adjusting idle timeouts for streaming.
Eng Oncall: Short mitigation suggestions for support: 1) Ask customer to enable idempotency-key header for generate calls so retries don't double-bill. 2) Upgrade to SDK 1.3.3-rc (it has smarter streaming backoff). 3) If using long prompts, enable chunked prompt upload to avoid single large body timeouts.
Priya K: Drafting the customer message. Proposed text:
"We're sorry for the disruption — we deployed a targeted keepalive fix to edge proxies and recommend trying SDK v1.3.3-rc which includes streaming backoff & idempotency helpers. If you still see resets, please attach the request-id and a client debug log. We've also opened a billing investigation for duplicate charge events." :pray:
Alex M: Also adding an internal note: check NGINX -> envoy timeout mismatch config and the LB health of the backend pool at 08:09-08:12. I left a flag for eng-runtime to check model worker restarts.
Deploy Bot: Canary deploy started: edge-proxy-keepalive-bump -> 5% (deploy id: dpl-7788)
Mike S: After canary rolled for ~8 minutes, the customer reported 0 502s in their sample window. They acknowledged improvement in streaming stability.
Eng Oncall: I'll keep the roll open and monitor p95 for 10m. Also creating follow-up to billing to reconcile the duplicate charge events and recommend idempotency-key usage in SDK docs.
Priya K: Sending customer update now and closing loop with billing. Will post final status here once billing confirms whether credits are issued. :white_check_mark:
